achievements.name: Sparkle Call
achievements.detail: Meet Stella in the Sparkle Theater and step into a play to help.

achievements.name: Swordfighter Debut
achievements.detail: Clear the Castle of Thorns as Swordfighter Peach.

achievements.name: Sweet Festival
achievements.detail: Finish a patissiere play by baking and decorating the treats on time.

achievements.name: Range Roundup
achievements.detail: Complete a cowgirl play and use the lasso to handle the troublemakers.

achievements.name: Ninja Scroll
achievements.detail: Clear a ninja play by hiding, climbing, and striking through the guards.

achievements.name: Case Closed
achievements.detail: Uncover the clues and solve the mystery in a detective play.

achievements.name: Ice Ovation
achievements.detail: Finish a figure-skating play and complete the routine on the ice.

achievements.name: Grand Heist
achievements.detail: Clear a dashing-thief play by crossing the stage with the hookshot.

achievements.name: Sea Melody
achievements.detail: Complete a mermaid play by guiding sea creatures with song.

achievements.name: Mighty Mission
achievements.detail: Finish a superhero play as Mighty Peach and protect the people on stage.

achievements.name: Kung Fu Tale
achievements.detail: Clear a kung fu play by overcoming the foes with strikes and kicks.

achievements.name: Final Curtain
achievements.detail: Win the Sparkle Theater's last play and light the stage again.
